title: Clicking an object on another layer doesn't make that layer active (Flash auto-switch)
description:
FIXED. Two coupled defects per the task detail.

ROOT CAUSE (1): single-layer hit-test. Selectable display-object arrays fed to StageArea were built only from the active layer (Shell.tsx *DisplayObjectsAt / derived.ts), so an object on a non-active layer was never hit-tested and the click fell through to the empty-stage marquee branch (deselect). (2): no active-layer-on-select wiring — none of the select paths called setActiveLayerIndex.

FIX (packages/authoring-ui):
- selectors/derived.ts: new isLayerStageSelectable (visible && !locked && type not guide/folder; mask/masked/guided/normal selectable), otherLayerSelectables(timeline, activeLayerIndex, frame) -> per-non-active-selectable-layer {shapes,instances,texts} in z-order, ownerSelectableLayerIndex(timeline, objectId, frame) -> owning selectable layer (-1 if none / locked / hidden / guide).
- Shell.tsx: maybeActivateOwnerLayer(id) resolves the owning selectable layer and calls setActiveLayerIndex. Wired into handleShapeSelectFromStage (single + shift), handleShapeSelectMultiple (front-most hit), and a new handleSubSelect wrapping setSubSelection (resolves SubSelection.shapeId -> layer; covers the vector-shape/subselection path from 1331/1361). Passes otherLayerSelectableObjects (new useMemo) to StageArea.
- StageArea.tsx: new otherLayerSelectables prop + LayerSelectables type. Added a cross-layer FALLBACK hit-test in the Selection-tool pointer-down, AFTER the active-layer shape/instance/text misses and BEFORE the empty-stage marquee branch: iterate other selectable layers front-to-back, on a hit call onShapeSelect(id) (Shell switches the active layer; object joins the active arrays next render and drags/edits normally). Skipped in symbol-edit mode.

Respects Flash nuance: locked/hidden/guide layers are excluded from BOTH selectability AND the auto-switch target. Multi-select unaffected (front hit drives the active layer; selection set logic unchanged).

VERIFY: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build -> green. authoring-ui suite: 1195 passed / 102 files / 0 failed (added regression src/__tests__/selectActivatesLayer.test.ts, 7 cases: instance + vector-shape owner resolution on a non-active layer, cross-layer enumeration, locked/hidden/guide gating, unknown-id -> -1). The only repo test failures are 2 PRE-EXISTING core FLA byte-match tests failing with ENOENT on fixtures/flash8-empty.fla (missing binary fixture; fail identically on the clean baseline; unrelated).
